  /* ==========================================================================

  .hobbies-container {

    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }
  .large-project-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);

  }

  .card-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #86868b;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .large-project-card .card-main-title {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
  }

  .card-visual-zone {
    width: 100%;
    background: #f5f5f7;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .card-tags-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .tag-chip {
    background: #e8e8ed;

  }

  .card-description {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #424245;
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* ==========================================================================
     2. 공통 그리드 및 통합 KPI 컴포넌트 스타일
     ========================================================================== */
  .hobbies-chart-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .hobbies-chart-box {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
  }

  .hobbies-kpi-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    width: 100%;
    background: #f5f5f7;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0.6rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .hobbies-kpi-item { text-align: center; }

  .hobbies-kpi-value { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f; font-family: monospace; }

  /* ==========================================================================
     3. Running 카드 전용 구조 스타일
     ========================================================================== */
  .pb-list-board {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 260px;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    background: #f5f5f7;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 20px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .pb-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .pb-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .pb-distance { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .pb-distance.full  { color: #FF2D55; }
  .pb-distance.half  { color: #AF52DE; }
  .pb-distance.k10   { color: #007AFF; }
  .pb-distance.k5    { color: #34C759; }
  .pb-time { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f; font-family: monospace; }

  .mileage-bar-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: 190px; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .mileage-bar-axis { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed; padding-bottom: 4px; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .mileage-bar-column { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 14%; height: 100%; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .mileage-bar-fill { width: 100%; background-color: #E5E5EA; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; }
  .mileage-bar-fill.active { background-color: #FF5733 !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255,87,51,0.2); }
  .mileage-bar-label { font-size: 0.65rem; color: #86868b; margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; }

  /* ==========================================================================
     4. Travel & Vibe Coding 전용 데스크톱/패드 기본 스쿼드 스타일

    display: grid;

    gap: 2rem;

  /* 태블릿 및 미디엄 스크린 제어선 (900px 이하 브레이크포인트 격리) */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {

    .squad-matrix-grid {

    /* 가로 폭 확장에 맞춰 들여쓰기 공간을 정밀 컴팩트화 */
    .squad-indent-list {
